acceptanceCriteria: Idle CPU at 10k tickets measured over at least 10 minutes with a profile attributing the cost.
Idle CPU is reduced to a recorded target agreed in the ticket, or each remaining periodic wake-up is justified.
body:
Observed: measured 1.44 CPU-seconds per minute idle at 10k tickets (scale-tasks lane, V1-0893). Owner goal: no CPU use unless essential. Expected: idle CPU near zero (event driven or documented minimum poll).

Source: batch 4 lanes for GitHub #641-#647, 2026-10-06 (branches claude/v1-0645-audit-outside-lock, claude/scale-tasks-v1-0893, claude/scale-core-v1-0416, claude/gh644-live-upgrade). Darwin 25.6.0, go1.27.1. Versions: corvint-tasks 0.0.0-tcp01-unverified+build.202; corvint 1.0.0-rc.2 (build 360).

completion.reason: Delivered in beamfall/corvint#795 (https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/pull/795; landed by batch PR #795); on main at 8b659142492966161ca82d1f5ff8f503fec1c504 (https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/pull/795). Tests named in the PR: CAL-V0-217 focused tasks idle full-read tests. Doc gates, repin check, independent review and dogfood bind/check/seal reported PASS in the PR. make gate NOT_RUN (owner scoped-work preference); native claim unavailable (COVERAGE_UNKNOWN/RESOURCE_COLLISION). Evidence: sha256 of the build-log/decision record(s) at the merge commit.

title: Tasks idle CPU at 10k tickets is 1.44 CPU-s/min; owner goal is no CPU use unless essential
